Class ItemPlacementView

java.lang.Object
fr.uge.graphics.view.ItemPlacementView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClickableItems
public class ItemPlacementView extends Object implements ClickableItems
Creates a view to place one item. It shows an item in a specific zone. This class uses item images and a delete view.
